catalog_quirks.body: Waterfall serves -free routes at no charge with no card under unpublished community rate limits. The ten listed routes returned matching model IDs on September 15. Twelve other -free routes (gemma-4 variants, nemotron-3-ultra, content-safety, laguna-xs, north-mini-code, dots-3, glm-5.2, ling-fin) returned 503 upstream_unavailable on two attempts and are not listed; inkling routes are forbidden and Lyria routes require payment.
catalog_quirks.title: Free routes depend on upstream availability
